text: Every day, technology moves a little faster.
And every day, someone gets left a little further behind.
It starts with a message she doesn't understand.
Is it real? What do I press? Who do I ask?
In 2025, people aged sixty and over reported losing seven point seven billion dollars to internet fraud.
A patient helper for the moments tech gets confusing.
Take a photo of your screen.
Companion explains it, and circles the exact spot to tap.
Then it waits while you try.
Before you tap a link, it explains what looks wrong.
A little less help every time. Until it's yours.
Stuck? Ask family, your way. Shared only when you say yes.
Growing technology is not a reason to leave others behind.
